k_of_n.quote: Severe aortic stenosis is defined by one or more of the following criteria

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate 'Contraindications' paragraph: 'cannot tolerate an anticoagulation/antiplatelet regimen or who have active bacterial endocarditis or other active infections'; also 'without severe aortic insufficiency' written as a positive criterion.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Members with an ejection fraction >20% who have been examined by a heart team ... who find the member: 1. inoperable and in whom existing co-morbidities would not preclude the expected benefit ...; or
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A numbered list with only item 1 followed by 'or' and then a bullet about the FDA PMA device; the intended items 2+ (e.g., high-risk) are missing, so the logic is broken.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: TAVR is considered medically necessary when all the following conditions are present: Severe aortic stenosis; and NYHA ... symptoms; Members with severe symptomatic calcified native aortic valve stenosis without severe aortic insufficiency; and ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Mixes 'and' at line ends inconsistently; the first two bullets lack the second 'and'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: An aortic valve area of less than <= 1.0 cm2
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Typographical: 'less than' plus '<='; strict vs inclusive unclear.

requirement_kinds.quote: aortic valve area ... <=1.0 cm2; AVA index <= 0.6 cm2/m2; mean gradient > 40 mmHg; Doppler jet velocity > 4.0 m/sec
New York Heart Association (NYHA) Heart Failure Class II, III or IV symptoms
severe symptomatic calcified native aortic valve stenosis without severe aortic insufficiency
examined by a heart team including both an experienced cardiac surgeon and a cardiologist who find the member: inoperable
complete aortic valve and implantation system that has received FDA premarket approval (PMA) for that system's FDA approved indication
cannot tolerate an anticoagulation/antiplatelet regimen or who have active bacterial endocarditis or other active infections
performed in a facility and by physicians that meets the institutional requirements set forth in the CMS NCD for TAVR

thresholds.quote: An aortic valve area of less than <=1.0 cm2
An aortic valve area index of less than or equal to 0.6 cm2/m2
A mean aortic valve gradient greater than 40mmHg
An echocardiographic Doppler jet velocity greater than 4.0 m/sec
NYHA Heart Failure Class II, III or IV symptoms
